At Callen, we turn your dreams into reality with custom home remodeling solutions that combine luxury, elegance, and unparalleled craftsmanship. Our unique design-build approach ensures your vision is at the heart of every project, transforming spaces into stunning, functional works of art.

From full-scale kitchen and bathroom renovations to beautifully crafted living areas and energy-efficient Infinity® Windows , our expert team will guide you every step of the way, bringing your unique style and personality to life. Callen Expands to Delafield: Bringing Luxury Home Remodeling Closer to Lake Country
May 26, 2026
CALLEN EXPANDS TO DELAFIELD: BRINGING LUXURY HOME REMODELING TO LAKE COUNTRY

Delafield has long been known for its scenic lakes, upscale neighborhoods, and homes that reflect both character and craftsmanship. As more homeowners in Lake Country invest in upgrading their spaces, the demand for high-end remodeling experiences continues to grow. Now, that experience is becoming more accessible than ever.

WHY DELAFIELD IS THE PERFECT FIT

Located in the heart of Lake Country, Delafield offers a unique blend of natural beauty and refined living. Homes here aren’t just places to live; they’re long-term investments, gathering spaces, and reflections of personal style. With that comes a need for remodeling solutions that go beyond surface-level updates. Homeowners are looking for thoughtful design, lasting materials, and a seamless process from concept to completion.

WHAT LUXURY REMODELING MEANS TODAY

Luxury home remodeling in Southeastern Wisconsin has evolved. It’s no longer just about aesthetics; it’s about how a space functions, feels, and adapts to everyday life.

Modern remodeling priorities often include:

Personalized kitchen spaces designed for both entertaining and daily use
Spa-inspired bathrooms that offer relaxation and efficiency
Energy-efficient upgrades like window replacement and door replacement
(including patio, storm, and entry doors)
Interior remodeling that maximizes both comfort and style

For homeowners in Delafield and throughout Lake Country, these upgrades are about creating a home that truly works for them.

BRINGING DESIGN AND BUILD TOGETHER

One of the biggest shifts in the remodeling industry is the move toward integrated design-build experiences. Instead of coordinating multiple vendors, homeowners are choosing streamlined approaches that combine design, planning, and remodeling under one roof.

This approach simplifies communication, improves timelines, and ensures every detail is aligned from the beginning. It also allows homeowners to fully visualize their project before their transformation begins, which is an advantage that reduces uncertainty and leads to better outcomes.

A CLOSER LOOK AT LOCAL REMODELING TRENDS

In Delafield, remodeling projects often reflect the surrounding environment. Homes near the water may focus on maximizing views and natural light, while others emphasize warm, inviting interiors that balance modern design with traditional elements. These projects aren’t just upgrades; they’re transformations that improve how homeowners live every day.

THE IMPORTANCE OF A LOCAL PRESENCE

Having a remodeling contractor rooted in the Delafield area means more than convenience. It means understanding the homes, the environment, and the expectations of local homeowners. From navigating seasonal challenges to recommending materials that perform well in Wisconsin weather, local expertise plays a key role in successful remodeling projects. It also makes the entire process more accessible, giving homeowners the opportunity to collaborate more closely and confidently.

A NEW OPPORTUNITY FOR HOMEOWNERS

With expanded access to high-end remodeling services in Delafield, homeowners now have the opportunity to approach their projects with a Design Center with curated displays featuring Kohler, Starmark Cabinetry, Infinity by Marvin, ProVia, and HomeStory Doors.Whether it’s a full home remodeling vision or targeted upgrades like kitchen remodeling or bathroom remodeling, the focus remains the same: creating spaces that are both beautiful and functional.

READY TO STEP INTO WHAT IS POSSIBLE?

Centered in the heart of Lake Country, our Delafield location brings the full Callen experience right to your neighborhood. With a focus on craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and a seamless experience, the path to a better home has never been clearer.

More than a Design Center, it is a space designed to spark ideas and make your vision tangible. Our team is here to guide you through design possibilities you may not have imagined – and help you move from inspiration to intention. Visit our Design Center to experience materials, layouts, and ideas firsthand, and connect with our team of Sales •Design Consultants to start shaping your vision.

KITCHENS
WHAT IS DESIGN BUILD?

Design-build is a streamlined and comprehensive approach to the creation and renovation of kitchens. With Callen, we manage both the design and construction aspects of your project. This integrated approach offers numerous benefits to clients, ensuring a smoother and more efficient journey from conception to completion. Experience the Callen difference and transform your kitchen with ease and expertise.

DESIGN

Conceptualization and Planning – The process begins with a collaborative discussion in our design center between you and your Sales • Design Consultant.

BUILD

Construction – Once the kitchen design is finalized and the budget is agreed upon, the construction phase begins. The same design-build team handles construction.

LIVE

Lasting Value – At Callen, we provide beautiful and functional kitchens that last a lifetime. Our commitment to quality and durability means every Callen home remodeling project delivers lasting value and satisfaction.

Design – Upon completion of the retainer agreement, your Sales • Design Consultant takes your input and creates detailed kitchen plans, drawings, and 3D views that bring your vision to life. This phase involves selecting finish materials, colors, space layout, and fixtures that align with your preferences and budget. The design-build approach ensures that practicality, aesthetics, and functionality are seamlessly integrated into the kitchen design.

‍

Budgeting and Cost Estimation – The design-build team provides an accurate cost estimate based on the kitchen design. Since the same team is responsible for both design and construction, they have a total understanding of how design choices impact costs, resulting in a more accurate budget assessment.

ABOUT CALLEN

Originally started in 1986 by two brothers, Callen has been providing home remodeling services to Southeastern Wisconsin residents for almost four decades. Under new ownership since 2023, our aim is to assure clients that we hold great respect for Callen’s legacy and heritage, while also being dedicated to moving the company forward to embrace the incredible amount of progress and innovation in building science and installation techniques. We are excited to have you, our clients, as part of this journey, and we look forward to serving you with the same level of excellence and commitment that Callen has always been known for.

HOME IMPROVEMENT EXPERTS IN DELAFIELD, WI

Discerning homeowners in Delafield, Wisconsin, turn to Callen for residential remodeling that reflects elegance, intention, and long-term value. Delafield Homeowners have a Design Center close by for inspiration and assistance. Known for a refined design-build process and elevated craftsmanship, Callen specializes exclusively in high-end residential renovation. Every home is approached as a complete environment, thoughtfully designed and expertly built to enhance daily living.

As trusted home improvement experts and home renovation specialists, Callen partners with homeowners who expect precision, transparency, and exceptional results from start to finish.

A REFINED DESIGN-BUILD PROCESS

Every remodeling project begins inside the Design Center, where homeowners collaborate directly with Callen’s Sales • Design Consultants, Project Managers, and carpentry team. This integrated process allows design, planning, and construction considerations to align from the very beginning, ensuring no detail is overlooked.

Rather than isolated updates, Callen delivers fully designed renovations that prioritize flow, balance, and cohesion throughout the home. This approach creates a smoother experience for the homeowner while producing refined, lasting results.

KITCHEN REMODELING DESIGNED AS A COMPLETE EXPERIENCE

Kitchen remodeling with Callen is rooted in full design, not partial upgrades. Each kitchen is planned as a complete space, accounting for layout, storage, lighting, cabinetry, and surface selections together. This ensures kitchens feel purposeful, elegant, and suited to both daily routines and entertaining.

Callen incorporates premium materials such as Starmark Cabinets, Ultracraft Cabinets, and Kohler faucets, selected to deliver durability and visual sophistication while complementing the home’s overall architectural style. If you are unsure of which styles will best suit your home, our Sales • Design Consultants can show you examples of our previous work and make suggestions that will elevate your home.

BATHROOM REMODELING WITH COMFORT AND LONGEVITY IN MIND

Bathrooms are designed as personal retreats that balance beauty with performance. Callen provides fully designed bathroom renovations that consider layout efficiency, moisture control, material durability, and long-term comfort as a unified plan. High-performance surfaces like Onyx are used for their clean appearance and lasting reliability, allowing bathrooms to maintain their elegance while supporting everyday use.

INTERIOR SPACES THOUGHTFULLY REIMAGINED

Beyond kitchens and bathrooms, Callen enhances interior living through fully designed renovations of main floors, laundry rooms, mudrooms, and attic conversions. These projects are carefully integrated into the home’s overall design language to ensure seamless transitions between spaces. Interior remodeling focuses on improving organization, flow, and usability while preserving a refined aesthetic throughout the home.

PREMIUM WINDOW INSTALLATION BUILT FOR STRENGTH

Callen installs Infinity® by Marvin® windows, manufactured from Ultrex fiberglass and engineered to be 8x stronger than vinyl. These windows offer superior durability, energy efficiency, and design flexibility for luxury homes.

All window services are installation-only. Callen does not perform repairs and will cut new openings when required to support the design vision. All window types are available except egress and skylights.

PRECISION DOOR INSTALLATION FOR REFINED HOMES

Door installation services are delivered with accuracy and efficiency. Callen installs ProVia entry and storm doors, HomeStory interior doors, and patio doors. HomeStory interior doors are laser-measured for precise fit and are not full-frame replacements, allowing for a clean, efficient installation.

All door services are installation-only, ensuring focus on craftsmanship and long-term performance.

SERVING DELAFIELD HOMEOWNERS WITH ELEVATED STANDARDS

WHAT IS DESIGN-BUILD?

Design-build is a streamlined and comprehensive approach to the creation and renovation of interior spaces. With Callen, we manage both the design and construction aspects of your project. This integrated approach offers numerous benefits to clients, ensuring a smoother and more efficient journey from conception to completion. Experience the Callen difference and transform your interior living space with ease and expertise.

DESIGN

Conceptualization and Planning – The process begins with a collaborative discussion in our design center between you and your Sales • Design Consultant.

BUILD

Construction – Once the interior living space design is finalized and the budget is agreed upon, the construction phase begins. The same design-build team handles construction.

LIVE

Lasting Value – At Callen, we provide beautiful and functional interior spaces that last a lifetime. Our commitment to quality and durability means every Callen home remodeling project delivers lasting value and satisfaction.

Design – Upon completion of the retainer agreement, your Sales • Design Consultant takes your input and creates detailed interior living space plans, drawings, and 3D views that bring your vision to life. This phase involves selecting finish materials, colors, space layout, and fixtures that align with your preferences and budget. The design-build approach ensures that practicality, aesthetics, and functionality are seamlessly integrated into the interior living space design.
‍

Budgeting and Cost Estimation – The design-build team provides an accurate cost estimate based on the bathroom design. Since the same team is responsible for both design and construction, they have a total understanding of how design choices impact costs, resulting in a more accurate budget assessment.

TRUE DESIGN-BUILD

Most design firms don't build. We do.

When your designer hands off to a subcontractor, details get lost, costs creep up, and no one owns the outcome.
We eliminated that gap 20 years ago.

Design Firms That Hire Out
True Design-Build at Transitions
Designers sell, subcontractors build

Beautiful renderings, but the designer hands the build off to a contractor, who hands it to subs. The people building it were never part of the design, so the details get lost.

We design it and we build it

Design, material selection, project management, demolition, carpentry, and installation are all handled by Transitions employees. The work most firms sub out, we do ourselves.

Costs creep up

Each sub prices their own piece, and the gaps between them turn into change orders. No one owns the total, so the price you were quoted isn't the price you pay.

The budget holds

Our owner, Craig, estimates every remodel himself, before you sign. Because one team owns the design and the build, the full scope is accounted for up front, so change orders are rare and the budget holds.

No one owns the outcome

When something goes wrong, it's often unclear who's responsible. The designer points to the sub, the sub points back. You're caught in the middle.

We own every outcome

From the first showroom visit to the final walkthrough, Craig stays personally involved. The result is ours, and we stand behind it.

A different crew every job

The plumber, electrician, and tile setter change from project to project. You hope for their best people and might get whoever was free that week.

The same trusted trades every time

The licensed work, plumbing, electrical, and tile, comes from the same trusted trades on every job. They've worked with us for years, they know our standard, and you have one firm to call if anything is ever off.

Inconsistent quality

What you get depends on which crew they hired that week. The renderings look the same. The finished work may not.

Consistent craftsmanship

The same skilled craftsmen who built your neighbor's kitchen will build yours. You can see their work, meet them in person, and trust who's coming to your home.

Do I need an appointment?

+

Walk-ins are welcome during business hours. Scheduling ahead just means a designer will be available to give you their full attention and answer project-specific questions.

How far in advance should I start planning?

+

We recommend reaching out 2-3 months before your ideal start date. Design, material selection, and ordering take time, starting earlier means a smoother process.

Is there a fee for the initial visit?

+

No. Your first showroom visit and conversation are completely free with no obligation. We want you to feel confident before making any commitment.

What area do you serve?

+

We're based in Norwell and have been working with homeowners across the South Shore and Greater Boston since 2006.

On the South Shore, we regularly work in Hingham, Cohasset, Scituate, Marshfield, Duxbury, Kingston, Plymouth, Hanover, Pembroke, Hanson, Halifax, Rockland, Abington, Whitman, Hull, Weymouth, Braintree, Holbrook, and Quincy.

West and inland, we work in Milton, Canton, Sharon, Easton, Norton, Norfolk, Norwood, Dedham, Westwood, Needham, Wellesley, Weston, Newton, and Brookline.

For materials-only projects, our reach is even broader, we've supplied cabinetry and finishes for homes as far as Martha's Vineyard.

We work on projects of all sizes, from materials only to a full first floor remodel, and we'd rather have an honest conversation about fit than turn anyone away based on zip code or budget. If you don't see your town listed or you're nearby and not sure, give us a call. Chances are we cover it.

Do you do home additions?

+

Smaller additions and bump-outs, yes, especially when they support a kitchen or bath layout we're already remodeling. Larger additions are case-by-case, typically when paired with a broader remodel. Reach out and we'll see if it's a fit.

Ready to reimagine your space?

Visit our showroom, meet our team, and see the Transitions difference for yourself.

OUR PROCESS
A clear path from first visit to finished space

We designed our process to take the uncertainty out of remodeling. A clear path, honest numbers, and one team responsible for every detail from start to finish.

N

3

FREE STEPS, NO COMMITMENT

12

STEPS START TO FINISH

1

TEAM, TOTAL ACCOUNTABILITY

PART ONE

Getting to Yes

Six clear steps. A complete design, full material selections, and a line-item budget in front of you before you sign anything.

PHASE 1  ·  DISCOVERY & DESIGN
01
Showroom Visit

Come see what’s possible. Tour our 5,000 sq ft showroom, meet your designer, and explore cabinetry and finishes in person, before any decisions are made.

Tour materials and displays side by side

Meet your designer, discuss your vision

Schedule your in-home measure before you leave

02
In-Home Measure

Your designer visits your home to confirm scope, take detailed field measurements, and document site conditions. The foundation for your design and budget.

Review wish list and confirm scope of work

Precise measurements and site photos

Design & Budget appointment confirmed

03
Design & Budget Appointment

We present initial design concepts alongside a preliminary budget, so you can see the vision and understand the investment before moving forward.

Initial concepts and layout options

Walkthrough of the preliminary budget

Gather feedback and refine selections

Design Agreement
5% deposit  ·  secures the design package
PHASE 2 · REFINEMENT & COMMITMENT
04
2nd Design Appointment (if needed)

We work through the remaining selections together, finishes, hardware, and anything still open, so the design is settled before construction planning begins.

Review and finalize all revisions

Confirm remaining material selections

Sign off on the final design

05
In-Home Construction Review

Our construction team walks your space with the finalized design to spot site conditions, refine pricing, and coordinate any trade work before anything is built.

Review finalized design on-site

Identify obstacles and refine pricing

Electrical and other trades coordinated

06
Final Budget & Materials

We lock in all material selections and deliver a detailed, line-item budget. Every number is clear and your project timeline is set before anything is signed.

Detailed line-item budget delivered

Project timeline established

Material selections confirmed, allowances set where choices are still open

Once the contract is signed, our construction team takes over.
A structured, managed process from the first day on site to your final walkthrough.

Permits & Preparation

Final site visit to verify conditions

Permit applications filed and tracked

Materials ordered, dumpster scheduled

COMMENCEMENT

Careful, methodical demolition begins

Surfaces and finishes protected

Debris removed from site daily

ROUGH CONSTRUCTION
Framing, Plumbing & Electrical

Wall framing, openings, structural work

Supply lines, drains, rough plumbing

Licensed inspections and code sign-offs

WALLS & FLOORS
Insulation, Plaster & Flooring

Fire foam, insulation, energy compliance

Blue board and plaster skim coat

Hardwood, tile, or LVP installed per plan

CABINETRY & COUNTERTOPS
Installation & Finish Plumbing

Cabinets set, leveled, and adjusted

Digital countertop template and fabrication

Fixtures, faucets, and drains installed

FINISH WORK & COMPLETION
Trim, Paint & Final Walkthrough

Finish electrical, devices, and fixtures

Interior trim, casing, base, and crown

Paint approval and final punch list walkthrough

ABOUT US
A family-owned design‑build firm

Transitions Kitchens & Baths is a full-service design-build firm serving the South Shore and Greater Boston since 2006. We handle everything from initial design and material selection to construction and final installation, all under one roof.

Meet Our Team
See Our Work
One Team
From start to finish
Expert Designers
Kitchen, bath & home
Skilled Remodelers
Built right, every time

WHAT SETS US APART

True design‑build means one team, one vision.

Many firms say they're "design-build." We actually are. Our designers, project managers, and builders all work together in-house — so nothing gets lost in translation.

One Integrated Team

No subcontractor roulette. The people who design your kitchen are steps away from the people who build it. That means better communication, fewer mistakes, and a finished product that matches the vision.

5,000 Sq Ft Showroom

See and touch real materials before you commit. Compare countertops, cabinetry, and fixtures side by side. The South Shore’s largest kitchen and bath showroom, not a sales office with a few samples.

Expert Design Guidance

Our designers guide you through every decision, including layout, materials, finishes, and budget, so you can make confident choices. No guessing, no buyer’s remorse, and no surprise costs down the road.

OUR PEOPLE

Meet the team behind your project.

Transitions is a family business. When you work with us, you work directly with the people who own and operate the company, along with a handpicked team of designers and craftsmen who share our standards.

OUR FAMILY
FOUNDER
Craig Ricciarelli

Craig has been running his own businesses for nearly 40 years. He founded Transitions in 2006 and still personally oversees every project that comes through the door.

Craig@transitionskbr.com
FINANCE & ADMINISTRATION
Linda Ricciarelli

Linda keeps the business running. Accounting, payroll, job costing, if it involves a dollar sign, it goes through her. Every project stays on track because of it.

Linda@transitionskbr.com
OPERATIONS
Nick Ricciarelli

Nick came back to the family business after a career in tech and now runs the operations and systems that keep the team organized and projects moving.

Nick@transitionskbr.com
OFFICE MANAGER
Annemarie Studholme

Annie is the glue that holds everything together. A lifelong friend of the family, she keeps the dots connected between our design team and remodeling crew.

Annemarie@transitionskbr.com
OUR TEAM
KITCHEN & BATH DESIGNER
John Donahue

A Braintree native, John has been designing beautiful kitchens since 1999 and brings a sharp eye for detail. He also leads our Builder Partnership Program, working closely with local contractors.

John@transitionskbr.com
KITCHEN & BATH DESIGNER
Karen King

Karen has been with Transitions since 2008. She's known for her color sense and her ability to curate material selections that make the decision process feel easy rather than overwhelming.

Karen@transitionskbr.com
KITCHEN & BATH DESIGNER
Veronica Dee Amelang

A Scituate native with over 20 years of design experience, Veronica knows the trends, but her real talent is listening. She designs the space around you and the way you actually live.

Veronica@transitionskbr.com
PROJECT MANAGER
PJ Mottola

PJ manages your project from pre-construction through final walkthrough. Once construction begins, he's your go-to for schedules, updates, and anything you need along the way.

PJ@transitionskbr.com
DEMO, FRAMING, INSTALLATION & MORE
Our Crew

Our crew has been working together for over ten years. From demo and framing to plumbing, electrical, tile, and finish carpentry, their craftsmanship is what turns designs into reality.

OUR COMMITMENT

These aren't words on a wall.

They’re the standards we hold ourselves to on every project, and the reason clients come back and refer their friends.

01
Transparency & Communication

No surprises. We keep you informed at every stage, from initial estimate to final walkthrough. You'll always know what's happening, what's coming next, and exactly what it costs.

02
Respect for Your Home & Time

We treat your home with care, protecting floors, cleaning up daily, and sticking to agreed-upon schedules as closely as possible. Your life doesn’t stop during a remodel.

03
High Standards of Craftsmanship

Quality work isn't negotiable. We take pride in what we build, sweat the details that most people won't notice, and stand behind every single project we complete and deliver.

04
Long-Term Relationships

Many of our clients return for additional projects or refer family and friends. That repeat trust is the best measure of our success, and we work hard to earn it every single time.

Rift Sawn Oak Primary Bath in Braintree

Braintree, MA

2026

Tedd Wood

View all 15 photos
A condo primary bath in Braintree, rebuilt from the studs with a rift oak vanity, freestanding tub, and walk-in glass shower.

This Braintree primary bath was rebuilt from the studs in a condo, where the toilet and shower had been closed off in a separate room. Opening that wall turned two tight spaces into one continuous bath.

A floating double vanity in rift sawn white oak, from the Tedd Wood line, anchors the room. It pairs with Arctic White quartz, two undermount sinks, and brushed nickel Riobel faucets. The back wall carries a dark botanical wallpaper behind two LED mirrors, with a rift oak panel running across the soffit above. A matching oak linen tower adds full-height storage.

The walk-in shower is finished in marble-look tile with a pebble stone floor, a built-in bench, and a niche with shelves. A freestanding Maax tub sits along the tiled wall with a wall-mounted filler.

Two-Tone Milton Kitchen with Navy Island

Milton, MA

2026

Mouser

View all 9 photos
Two-tone Mouser kitchen with a navy island, marble herringbone backsplash, custom hood, and storage built around real life.

This Milton kitchen remodel was designed around how a busy family actually lives. Homework at the island on a Tuesday, eight people for dinner on a Sunday, and a steady rotation of coffee, snacks, and cooking in between. The layout had to absorb all of it without ever feeling crowded.

The space is anchored by a deep navy island in Mouser's Nook door style, finished in Indigo Island. The perimeter is the same Mouser semi-custom cabinetry line in the Divinity door style, finished in Haven White. Same maker, same construction quality, two doors that read very differently next to each other. The white perimeter keeps the room bright and quiet while the navy island gives the eye a place to land.

A Calacatta Abrezza marble herringbone mosaic runs across every backsplash in the kitchen, including the cooking wall and the coffee bar nook. Using one stone everywhere keeps the room calm and lets the navy island stand as the focal point. The custom range hood is painted to match the perimeter cabinets so the cooking wall reads as one clean composition.

FIRST FLOOR REMODEL
New Entry, New Kitchen, New Mudroom Addition

Marshfield, MA

2025

Mouser

View all 16 photos
A Marshfield family wanted a brighter kitchen, so we reworked the entire first floor to get it.

This Marshfield family wanted more natural light in their kitchen. The way to get it was not a bigger window alone. It was rethinking the whole first floor. The old pantry and laundry sat exactly where the light needed to come in, so we moved them into a new addition off the back of the house. That freed up room to grow the kitchen and made space for a large window over the sink, with the backyard and the trees now in view while you work.

Opened to the great room. We took down the wall between the kitchen and the two-story great room and set a beam in its place, so the two spaces read as one. The kitchen borrows light and height from the room next door, and the family can cook, eat, and gather without walls between them.

A backsplash that anchors the room. Behind the cooktop, a single slab of granite runs the full height of the wall. Its gold and charcoal veining sits against high-gloss white cabinetry and warm bamboo, and it is the piece your eye finds the moment you walk in.

This Hingham family came back to us a year after we did their upstairs bath, this time with a bigger vision for the first floor. To give the kitchen the space it deserved, we removed a hallway running to the backyard, relocated and reconfigured the first floor bath, moved the laundry, and shifted the staircase to the second floor. All designed and built as one project.

We replaced the old recessed side entry with a full mudroom addition, taking the structure down to the foundation, pouring new footings, and adding radiant floor heat, Mouser cabinetry in Twilight blue-gray, white beadboard, custom cubbies, and a patterned porcelain tile floor.

The kitchen pairs white Mouser perimeter cabinetry in the Plaza Door style with a sage green island in the same line. Silestone Calacatta Gold counters run throughout. The backsplash is a soft gray picket tile, and brass pendants and sconces tie the room together. An Elkay workstation sink sits under the window, with a Thermador range, integrated paneled refrigerator, and a beverage station built into the island.

Whole-home materials and install on a Milton new build: kitchen, four baths, mudroom, laundry, dining hutch, and fireplace.

When the builder broke ground on this Milton new build, Transitions came in as the design and install partner for the spaces that needed cabinetry, tile, and finish work. The kitchen, the bathrooms, the mudroom, the laundry, the dining room hutch, and the fireplace surround all came through us, from selection to install, as part of our materials and installation service.

The kitchen is anchored by Tedd Wood cabinetry with a Sandy White perimeter in the Graceland raised panel door style and a contrasting island. Quartz countertops, an undermount stainless sink, and a Riobel faucet round out the workspace. Top Knobs hardware in Honey Bronze runs through the kitchen and ties into the rest of the first floor.

The primary bath uses a Tedd Wood double vanity in Naval finish with brushed nickel hardware, a marble countertop, and a fully tiled walk-in shower with a built-in bench and recessed niche. MSI Dymo Stripe runs on the wall and Azula Hatchworks covers the floor, two patterned tiles that bring movement without taking over the room.

WHY A WHOLE-FLOOR REMODEL

A first floor that finally flows.

Most homes we walk into have been remodeled piece by piece over the years, a kitchen one decade, a bath the next. A first floor remodel is the chance to start fresh, with every space designed to work with the next.

One Cohesive Design

Cabinetry, trim, flooring, and finishes that carry across every room, because they were designed together from day one.

One Team, Start to Finish

Your designer and project manager stay with you from the first sketch to the final walkthrough. No handoffs, no dropped details.

Done Once, Done Right

Doing it all at once means less disruption, better pricing on overlapping trades, and a home you won't need to renovate again.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

What a first floor remodel covers.

No two projects are the same. Some start with a kitchen and grow from there. Others reimagine the whole main level at once. We'll walk your home with you, listen to how you live in it, and help you decide what stays, what changes, and how it all fits together.

Kitchens
Custom cabinetry, countertops, and layout, plus every detail in between
Bathrooms and powder rooms
Refreshed, relocated, or added to fit the new layout
Living and dining areas
Opened up, reconnected, and unified with matching trim and finishes
Mudrooms, pantries, and laundry
The workhorse spaces that make a first floor actually function
Fireplaces and built-ins
Custom carpentry that turns architectural features into focal points
Structural work
Walls removed or added, beams installed, openings reframed
Flooring, lighting, and finishes
Continuous across the whole floor for a cohesive, finished feel

WHY A WHOLE-FLOOR REMODEL

Two paths to the same result.

Every home is different, and so is every remodel. The goal is always the same, a first floor that finally works the way you live. How we get there depends on your home, your goals, and what the design calls for.

WITHIN THE FOOTPRINT
Rethinking the space you have.
Walls come down, rooms reconnect, and the first floor starts to breathe. For most homes, this is all it takes. The bones were good. The layout was just working against you.
EXPANDING THE FOOTPRINT
When a little more room is the answer.
Sometimes the best design needs a bit more square footage, a kitchen bump-out, a first-floor primary suite, a bigger mudroom. When that's the case, we handle it as part of the larger remodel, with the same team, the same schedule, and the same care.

THE DESIGN-BUILD DIFFERENCE

Built by the team that designed it.

A first floor remodel has a lot of moving parts. Cabinetry, millwork, flooring, tile, lighting, plumbing, electrical, framing, all connecting across multiple rooms. One detail off, and you can feel it.

That's why we keep design and construction under one roof. One team is accountable for the whole project, from the first sketch to the final walkthrough. No handoffs. No finger-pointing. Just a home that came out the way it was supposed to.

The Advantage of Custom New Construction
Why build new instead of remodeling? New construction offers complete control over every element, resulting in maximum efficiency, value, and personalization.
Zero Compromise
There are no existing walls, layouts, or structural limitations to restrict your creativity. You dictate the exact floor plan, ceiling heights, window placement, and room flow, resulting in a home that is 100% optimized for your needs.
Integrated Efficiency
New builds allow us to integrate the latest energy-efficient systems from the foundation up. This includes superior insulation, modern HVAC, solar readiness, and smart home technology that significantly reduces lifetime utility costs and increases property value.
Lasting Quality & Peace of Mind
With all-new materials and systems, you eliminate the risk and expense associated with hidden issues in older homes (e.g., outdated wiring, plumbing, and foundations). Your investment is protected by comprehensive warranties on every system and component.
Code Compliant Design
We ensure your entire structure is designed and built to meet the very latest California building codes and seismic standards, providing maximum security and long-term peace of mind.

Better Remodels Referral Program
Refer a Friend. Help Them Remodel. Get $500 Off.

Love the work Better Remodels has done for your home?

Share Better Remodels with a friend, family member, neighbor, or someone you know who is ready to transform their home.

When your referral becomes a qualifying full-home remodeling customer, you receive $500 off and your referred friend receives $500 off their qualifying full-home remodel.

That’s $1,000 in total savings for two homeowners.

REFER SOMEONE & SAVE $500

Give $500. Get $500.

We believe the best compliment a homeowner can give us is a referral.

That’s why we’re rewarding our customers for introducing Better Remodels to people they know.

When your referral qualifies:

YOU GET $500 OFF
Your next qualifying full-home remodeling project with Better Remodels.

THEY GET $500 OFF
Their qualifying full-home remodeling project with Better Remodels.

EVERYONE WINS
They get the home they’ve been dreaming about, and you get rewarded for spreading the word.

How the Referral Program Works

It’s simple.

1. Refer Someone You Know

Tell a friend, family member, neighbor, or colleague about Better Remodels.

Have them mention your name when they contact us, or submit the referral through our referral form.

2. They Meet With Better Remodels

We’ll connect with your referral to learn about their home, remodeling goals, and project.

3. They Start Their Full-Home Remodel

Once your referral enters into a qualifying full-home remodeling agreement with Better Remodels, the referral reward becomes eligible according to the program terms.

4. You Both Receive $500 Off

Your referred homeowner receives $500 off their qualifying full-home remodel, and you receive $500 off your qualifying full-home remodel.

Who Can You Refer?

Almost anyone who is thinking about transforming their home.

Refer someone who is:

Planning a full-home remodel
Buying a home and considering renovations
Preparing to update an older home
Looking to improve multiple areas of their home
Considering a major home transformation
A friend, family member, neighbor, or colleague

If they’re thinking about remodeling, send them our way.

Why Refer Better Remodels?
You Already Know the Difference

Choosing a remodeling company is a big decision.

Your friends and family don’t have to search endlessly or wonder who they can trust. You can simply share the company you already know.

Quality Remodeling

We help homeowners transform their spaces with thoughtful design, quality materials, and professional remodeling services.

A Better Experience

From planning through completion, our goal is to make the remodeling process clear, organized, and straightforward.

A Reward for Sharing

When your referral becomes a qualifying customer, both of you benefit.

Your Referral Could Be Worth $500

Imagine your friend has been talking about remodeling their home for years.

You tell them about Better Remodels.

They decide to move forward.

They save $500.

And when you’re ready for your own qualifying full-home remodel:

You save $500 too.

That’s what we call a referral worth sharing.

Ready to Refer Someone?
Know Someone Who’s Ready for a Better Home?

Introduce them to Better Remodels today.

Fill out the referral form below and tell us who you’d like to refer.

REFER A FRIEND

Or have them contact Better Remodels directly and mention your name when they get in touch.

Referral Program FAQs
How much do I receive for a referral?

Eligible Better Remodels customers can receive $500 off a qualifying full-home remodeling project when their referral meets the program requirements.

How much does my referral receive?

Your referred customer receives $500 off their qualifying full-home remodeling project.

Does the $500 discount apply to any remodeling project?

The referral offer is specifically for qualifying full-home remodeling services. It does not automatically apply to individual rooms, repairs, maintenance, or other services unless Better Remodels specifically confirms otherwise.

When does my referral qualify?

A referral qualifies when the referred customer enters into a qualifying full-home remodeling agreement with Better Remodels and satisfies the applicable program requirements.

Does my referral need to mention my name?

Yes. To make sure we can properly connect the referral to you, your referred customer should provide your name when they first contact Better Remodels or submit the referral information through our referral form.

Can I refer more than one person?

Yes. You may refer multiple people. Each referral is subject to the program’s eligibility requirements.

Can I refer a family member?

Yes. Friends, family members, neighbors, coworkers, and other personal contacts may be eligible referrals, provided they meet the program requirements.

Can I refer someone who is already talking to Better Remodels?

Generally, a referral must be a new customer or prospective customer who was not already actively engaged with Better Remodels before the referral was submitted.

If you’re unsure, contact our team before submitting the referral.

Can I receive the $500 as cash?

No. The referral reward is provided as a $500 discount toward a qualifying Better Remodels full-home remodeling project and is not redeemable for cash.

Can my $500 discount be combined with other promotions?

Referral discounts may not be combined with certain other offers or promotions. Please ask the Better Remodels team about current promotions and eligibility.

Is there a limit to how many people I can refer?

You may refer multiple people, but each referral must independently satisfy the program requirements.

Share Better Remodels. Save Together.

A great remodel is worth talking about.

If someone you know is ready to create a home they love, introduce them to Better Remodels.

They get $500 off.
You get $500 off.
And two homeowners get one step closer to a better home.

REFER A FRIEND TODAY

Referral Program Terms

The Better Remodels Referral Program is available subject to eligibility and program requirements. The $500 referral discount applies to qualifying full-home remodeling services only. The referred customer must be a new Better Remodels customer and must identify the referring customer at the time of initial contact or through the designated referral process. The referred customer must enter into a qualifying remodeling agreement and satisfy any applicable minimum project requirements established by Better Remodels.

The $500 discount is applied toward the applicable qualifying remodeling project and has no cash value. Referral discounts are not transferable and may not be redeemed for cash. Referral discounts may not be combined with certain other discounts, promotions, or offers unless expressly approved by Better Remodels.

Better Remodels reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the referral program or its terms at any time. Additional eligibility requirements may apply. Please contact Better Remodels for complete program details.

remodel cost?

More than 450 local homeowners have used the 2026 Better Remodels Cost Quiz to plan their budget with confidence.

Bonus: Receive a complimentary 3D Design Consultation when you complete the quiz.

Begin Your 2026 Estimate
Est. 2 minutes · No obligation
WHY TAKE THE QUIZ
What does a remodel cost in
Orange County?

Budgeting for a renovation in Southern California shouldn’t be a guessing game. Thousands of residents in Irvine, Newport Beach, and across Orange County have used our cost calculator to bridge the gap between inspiration and reality.

Answer a few quick questions to receive a personalized price range for your specific project — no obligation required.

Take The Quiz Now
What to expect

Investing in kitchen remodeling or a bathroom renovation is a significant decision that impacts your home’s value and your daily quality of life. With hundreds of material options and varying labor standards, finding a clear starting point is difficult. That is why we developed the Better Remodels Instant Quote Quiz — allowing our experienced team to analyze your needs and provide a realistic breakdown.

THE COST MATRIX
What Factors Impact Your Estimate?

When searching for remodeling contractors, it’s important to understand that every quote is influenced by specific variables. Our quiz accounts for:

Square Footage

The total footprint of the kitchen or bathroom directly influences material quantities and labor hours. OC Average: Kitchens 120–200 sq ft · Bathrooms 50–100 sq ft

Structural Changes

Whether you are moving walls or plumbing stacks significantly impacts the engineering and permit requirements.

Material Grade

From custom cabinetry and quartz countertops to luxury vinyl or tile — your selections define the investment level.

Scope of Work

Simple cosmetic updates versus a full “studs-out” renovation produce dramatically different budgets.

You might not have every detail finalized yet — most homeowners don’t! Answer to the best of your ability.

About Bennett Contracting

Bennett Contracting is a full-service remodeling contractor dedicated to providing the highest level of service and craftsmanship to help improve existing homes and businesses in the Capital Region. With over 80 employees including carpenters, plumbers, electricians, designers, and office staff, we are prepared to help plan and design any remodeling project.

Founded in 1915 by Dan Bennett in Delmar, New York, the company evolved over 100 years from a small plumbing company to a full-service remodeling contractor. Dan’s sons-in-law grew the plumbing business into DA Bennett Heating & AC following WWII. One of Dan’s grandson’s, Greg Jackson, and childhood friend, Paul Gutman, established the DA Bennett Insulation division in the late 1970s. This division eventually broke off into its own company called Bennett Contracting, Inc. in 1984, and was led by Greg and Paul for over 40 years.

In 2019, Andrew Gutman and Kevin Gutman took over as the owners of Bennett Contracting. This transition plan was developed to ensure that the company is safely on its way to a second one hundred years in business. Firsthand involvement by the owners ensures that Bennett’s high standards are passed on to every customer on every project.

From kitchens and bathrooms to additions, windows, doors, siding, and outdoor living spaces, we help improve the comfort, function, and longevity of existing homes. Our approach is practical, collaborative, and grounded in how people actually live in their spaces.

Our Capital Region home remodeling services include:

The replacement of Windows, Doors and Siding
The design and renovation of Kitchens, Bathrooms and Basements
The design and building of Home Additions
The design and installation or renovation of Decks, Porches or Seasonal Rooms

We believe great remodeling is built on trust—and that trust is earned by doing what we say we’ll do, showing up when we say we will, and standing behind our work.

Our Purpose

At Bennett Contracting, our purpose is to serve our customers and employees with integrity and care, and to improve homes and uphold a century-long commitment to our community through exceptional craftsmanship.

Our Vision

To be the Capital Region’s most trusted name in home remodeling: where craftsmanship meets care, and every project begins a lasting relationship.

Our Mission

We transform houses into homes through expert design, quality construction, and personal service. With a hands-on approach and a collaborative mindset, we provide solutions and guide our clients through every step of the remodeling journey, delivering spaces they’re proud to live in and eager to share. We support our employees with a culture of teamwork, growth, and pride in our shared legacy.

Our Values

Since 1915, Bennett Contracting has been guided by values that shape how we work today.

Trust
We’ve earned our reputation over generations by doing what we say we’ll do, when we say we’ll do it.

Reliability
We offer dependability, stability and consistency to our customers and coworkers.

Uncompromised Quality
We hold ourselves to the highest standards of quality, from the jobsite to the office.

Service
We prioritize people-our customers, coworkers, and community-above all else.

Teamwork
We believe the best work happens together. Every voice matters, and every contribution counts.

Embrace Progress
We learn from experience, encourage new ideas, and strive to constantly innovate how the business operates to stay ahead of the industry.

Do the Right Thing
Honesty and integrity serve as the foundation of how we do business and treat our coworkers.

1
2
3
Previous
Next
Family Owned and Operated

Bennett Contracting entered its fourth generation as a family-owned business in 2019. Brothers Andrew and Kevin Gutman assumed ownership following decades of leadership by Greg Jackson and Paul Gutman.

Today, Andrew and Kevin remain actively involved in day-to-day operations, ensuring Bennett’s standards for quality, reliability, and safety are upheld on every project.

Professional, Responsive, and Local

Strong communication is a key part of a successful remodeling experience. From our fully staffed home office and showroom at 693 S. Pearl Street in Albany, NY, customers can always reach a knowledgeable professional for timely answers and reliable support.
See all the communities we serve.

Just as important are the people behind the work. From our experienced office staff to our skilled carpenters and craftsmen in the field, Bennett’s team brings professionalism, coordination, and care to every project. That consistency—across design, construction, and communication—is a key reason homeowners continue to choose Bennett and refer us to others.
Meet our team.

Safety Is a Core Standard

Safety is fundamental to how Bennett operates. Protecting our employees, our customers, and the homes we work in is a responsibility we take seriously on every project.

That commitment is reinforced through regular safety meetings, ongoing training, and our annual Safety Fest, where teams come together for hands-on education and shared learning around best practices on the jobsite. Our approach to safety has also earned industry recognition, including national awards for safety programming from the National Association of Home Builders. 

While we’re proud of that recognition, what matters most is the day-to-day culture behind it; organized jobsites, consistent workmanship, and accountability at every level.

100 Year History
Reliability. Trust. Quality. Value.

These are the ideas on which Bennett Contracting was first founded in 1915. As a third generation family run house contractor business based in Albany, NY, we are proud to stand behind the belief that every project, no matter how big or small, deserves our utmost attention and care. What began as a small plumbing business has currently expanded to a substantial company with a fleet of over 35 cars, trucks and trailers and 70 full-time professional employees.

Company Timeline

1915:  Dan (D.A.) Bennett opens a plumbing shop in a rented garage in Delmar, NY.

“Dan learned his trade as a steam fitter on the railroad.  In 1915 indoor plumbing and central heat were a “new thing” and he was able to take his skills and move into this new industry.  Things were simpler then, workers paid in cash at the end of the day and contracts written on the back of old envelopes.” 

-Greg Jackson, Co-Founder Bennett Contracting.

 

1945:  Dan’s sons-in-law Gill and Bud return form WWII and join the company, which becomes DA Bennett Plumbing & Heating.  The company enjoys strong post war growth along with the Bethlehem community.

 

1976:  Gil’s son Tom joins the company and at the suggestion of long time friend Paul Gutman starts an insulation business.  Greg Jackson, another grandson, joins to run the new insulation company, DA Bennett Insulation Company.

 

1978:  Paul Gutman join Greg Jackson as co-owners of the DA Bennett Insulation Company.

“At the time we started the insulation business we did less work in a year than we do now in a week.  Our office was a warehouse our office walls were bags on insulation.  We shared a double desk and single rotary phone, if you needed a photo copy you took a dime and went to the library.”  

-Greg Jackson, Co-Founder Bennett Contracting.

 

1984:  Paul and Greg become the sole owners of the newly named Bennett Contracting, Inc.  They move the business to their current location at 693 S Pearl St in Albany, NY.

“During these years the company came of age and grew from 10 employees to over 70 today.  It expanded beyond insulation into a full-service remodeling firm, with the development of our insurance, commercial, and home remodeling services.  Our kitchen and bath business increased 1000%.  We have since added adjacent land and built offices, showroom and warehousing.” 

-Paul Gutman, Co-Founder Bennett Contracting.

 

1990’s & 2000’s: The business grows and expands into new products and services. Beyond just windows and insulation, the company enters into residential general contracting and commercial renovations. The office and field staff increase to around 50 employees by 2010.

 

2010: Ground is broken on Bennett Contracting’s first major office expansion. A 3-story addition is added, providing space for a new showroom, more offices and meeting space in the basement.

 

2016: Bennett’s evolution leads to bringing design in house. Our first designer, Justina Auer, joins the team and Bennett becomes a dealer of cabinets and countertops in order to support to support their robust remodeling projects. This allows for Project Manager to take full control of the projects from start to finish, without the need for relying on third parties.

 

2019: Andrew and Kevin Gutman purchase the business from Paul Gutman and Greg Jackson, entering its fourth generation of ownership for the Bennett brand. The company stands at about 75 employees and has garnered an exceptional reputation in the region for home renovations.

“We are committed to continue our 100 plus year tradition of quality and integrity in the remodeling and renovation business.  Dedicating ourselves to the success of our employees and the service of our customers, neighbors, and friends.”

-Andrew Gutman, President Bennett Contracting.

Remodeling Projects in Albany & the Capital Region

Bennett Contracting is a full-service home remodeling contractor serving Albany and the greater Capital Region. For more than 100 years, we’ve helped homeowners update the rooms they live in every day, improve comfort and efficiency, and protect the long-term value of their homes.

This page is a guide to the most common project types we build: from kitchen remodeling and bathroom renovations to replacement windows and doors, siding, decks and porches, and home additions. If you’re not sure where to start, that’s normal. Most great projects begin with a simple question: What would make your home work better for you right now?

Our team is built for clarity. We don’t do high-pressure, commission-driven sales. We offer no-pressure consultations led by experienced professionals, so you can make the right decision for your home, on your timeline.

Kitchens | Bathrooms | Windows | Doors | Siding | Decks & Porches | Additions | FAQs

Explore Our Remodeling Services
Window Replacement & Installation

Drafty frames, fogged panes, and windows that no longer insulate the way they should are common across older homes in the Capital Region. Bennett installs high-performance replacement windows designed for comfort, durability, and clean architectural fit — whether you’re upgrading a historic Albany property or a newer suburban home. We help you compare materials, understand energy performance, and choose options that make sense for your home and your budget.

Our approach is straightforward and professional. Openings are protected, installations are precise, and your home is respected throughout the process. Estimates are guided by experienced professionals — not commission-based sales tactics — so you can make the right decision without pressure.

Explore Window Replacement Services

Not sure what you need? Schedule a no-pressure consultation

Exterior & Entry Door Installation

Exterior doors shape first impressions, protect against Upstate weather, and play a critical role in efficiency and security. Bennett installs entry doors, patio doors, and specialty exterior doors with careful attention to structure, insulation, and finish details. We walk you through material and performance options so you understand the long-term impact before moving forward.

From initial assessment to final trim work, our installations are handled with discipline and clarity. We explain the scope, protect the opening properly, and execute with care — ensuring the door looks right, seals properly, and performs reliably through every season.

Explore Door Installation Services

Not sure what you need? Schedule a no-pressure consultation

Bathroom Remodeling

A bathroom remodel should do two things at once: make daily routines easier, and make the room feel like it finally fits the home. Bennett’s bathroom remodeling team handles full renovations — not quick cover-ups — with the plumbing, electrical, tile, and finish work required to get it right.

Whether you’re updating a primary bath, improving a guest bath, or planning for aging-in-place comfort, we help you make smart choices that balance durability, maintenance, and design. Good bathrooms aren’t built from trends. They’re built from details: ventilation that actually works, waterproofing you don’t have to think about, storage that’s intentional, and finishes that feel clean and lasting.

Our process is designed to reduce stress. We’ll talk through scope early, outline realistic timelines, and communicate clearly as the project moves from design to build.

Explore Bathroom Remodeling

Read: How Long a Bathroom Remodel Takes | Project Highlight: Bathroom Remodel in Loudonville

Kitchen Remodeling

Kitchens are where homes reveal their real habits. Who cooks. Who hosts. Who drops backpacks on the same corner every day. A successful kitchen remodel improves workflow and storage without losing the character of the home, especially in older Capital Region properties where “simple updates” often uncover hidden complexities.

Bennett provides full-service kitchen remodeling, including design guidance, layout updates, cabinetry and countertop coordination, lighting, flooring, and finish carpentry. Whether you’re opening sightlines, improving storage, or building a kitchen that finally feels like it belongs in the home, our team manages the details that make the difference: transitions, clearances, trim, and the small functional decisions you’ll live with for years.

If you’re deciding between a light refresh and a full renovation, we’ll help you weigh value, timeline, and disruption – with honest guidance, not pressure.

Explore Kitchen Remodeling

Read: Kitchen Remodel Budget Considerations (Capital Region) | Project Highlight: An Inviting Kitchen Remodel

Decks & Porches

Outdoor projects are where function meets seasonality. A deck or porch should feel like a natural extension of the home: built to handle Northeast weather, daily use, and the kind of summer you actually want to have.

Bennett designs and builds decks and porches that prioritize structure and longevity first, then finishes. That means thoughtful framing, clean connections to the home, and material choices that make sense for your maintenance preferences (natural wood vs composite, covered vs open-air, screened vs fully exposed). We also help homeowners plan early enough to align design decisions with build schedules, because outdoor timelines fill up fast.

If you’re thinking “we want something simple,” we’ll translate that into scope you can trust — the kind that doesn’t surprise you halfway through.

Explore Decks & Porches

Read: 5 Signs You Might Need a New Deck | Project Highlight: A Delightful Deck in Clifton Park

Siding Installation

Siding is one of those projects that’s easy to underestimate — until you see what it changes. Done well, siding improves curb appeal, reduces maintenance, protects the building envelope, and can solve real problems like moisture intrusion or persistent drafts.

Bennett installs siding with a builder’s mindset. We look at what’s happening underneath: trim, flashing, corner details, and how water moves across the exterior. Then we recommend a solution that fits your home, your neighborhood, and your long-term maintenance preferences. This matters even more in Upstate conditions, where freeze-thaw cycles and older construction can expose weaknesses over time.

If you’re comparing options (materials, profiles, color, insulation), we’ll walk you through tradeoffs clearly — and help you make a decision you won’t regret five years from now.

Explore Siding Services

Read: 4 Myths About Vinyl Siding | Project Highlight: New Siding on a Modern Home

Additions & Whole-Home Remodeling

Some homes don’t need a single-room fix. They need a new plan. Additions and whole-home remodels are about creating space that fits the next phase of life, whether that means a new primary suite, expanded kitchen footprint, a better mudroom entry, or a multi-room reconfiguration that finally makes the home flow.

These projects require more than good carpentry. They require project management, coordination, and clear communication because the scope touches structure, mechanicals, permits, and schedule sequencing. Bennett’s team is built for that complexity. We manage the process with discipline and guide decisions early to keep the build stage predictable.

If you’re exploring a bigger vision but want a grounded path forward, this is where a no-pressure consult helps most: we can discuss feasibility, budget ranges, and next steps without locking you into anything.

Explore Additions & Remodeling
Not Sure Where to Start? Choose the Right Project Type

If you’re debating where to invest first, start with what’s most “structural” to your daily comfort.

If your home feels drafty or loud: windows and doors often deliver the fastest comfort upgrade.
If daily routines feel cramped: kitchens and bathrooms typically have the biggest lifestyle impact.
If the exterior looks tired or maintenance-heavy: siding can change both appearance and protection.
If you’ve outgrown the layout: additions and reconfigurations create long-term solutions.

The best next step isn’t guessing. It’s a conversation. We’ll help you prioritize based on your home, your goals, and your timeline – without pressure.

Talk to an expert
The Bennett Difference

No-pressure. Expert-led. Built to last.

Bennett is not a high-pressure, commission-based sales organization. Our consultations are guided by experienced professionals who focus on the right solution, not a quick close.

What that means for you:

Clear scope, early. We define what’s included (and what isn’t) before work begins.
Process you can follow. You’ll know what happens next, and why.
Craft you live with. We treat finish details like they matter. Because they do.
A century of reputation. Trust is earned in the long run. We’ve been doing that since 1915.
FAQs
What areas do you serve?

We serve homeowners across Albany, Saratoga, Rensselaer, Schenectady, Fulton, and Montgomery Counties, with select projects in Columbia and Greene Counties depending on service type and schedule.

Do you offer no-pressure estimates?

Yes. Our process is built for clarity, not pressure. We’ll walk through your goals, evaluate your home, and provide an honest recommendation and estimate — without “today only” tactics.

How long does a remodel take?

Timelines depend on scope, selections, and scheduling. A window or door replacement may be completed quickly, while kitchens, bathrooms, and additions require more planning and build time. We’ll outline expected milestones before construction begins.

How much will my project cost?

Costs vary based on scope, materials, and site conditions. We’ll give you a clear estimate after discussing your goals and evaluating the space. If you’re early in planning, we can also walk you through the main cost drivers so you know what to expect.

Will I need permits?

Many projects require permits depending on scope and municipality. We’ll advise you early and handle permitting steps as part of the process when required.

Do you offer financing?

Yes. Bennett Contracting offers financing options through a trusted lending partner to help make larger projects more manageable. We view financing as a convenience — not a sales tool — and we’re happy to walk you through available options if it helps align your project timing with your budget.

Ready to plan a project you’ll feel good about for years?

Whether you know exactly what you want, or you’re still figuring it out, we’ll help you find the right path forward.

Request a Consultation.  See our recent work

Professional Bathroom Remodelers in Albany, NY

Your bathroom is one of the most important spaces in your home—it should be both functional and inviting. A thoughtful renovation can transform your bathroom into a stylish, comfortable, and efficient space that meets your family’s needs and reflects your personal taste.

Is It Time to Update Your Bathroom?

Normal wear and tear, like cracked tiles, persistent leaks, or mold, is often the first sign your bathroom needs a remodel. Other key reasons to renovate include

Updating your bathroom can modernize the space and bring it up to date with current design trends.
Renovating allows you to accommodate a growing family, fewer users, or make the bathroom safer for aging in place.
Upgrading to water-efficient toilets, showers, and faucets can save money and improve energy efficiency.

Work with a trusted local contractor, such as Bennett Contracting, who understands Upstate New York homes and ensures every bathroom remodel is completed with care and precision.

Request A Quote
Key Considerations for a Bathroom Remodel in New York’s Capital Region

There are many benefits to planning a bathroom remodel. Some key considerations you should include are

Clean Look & Feel: Refresh your bathroom with a sleek, modern design.
Storage & Accessibility: Updated cabinets, shelving, and layouts improve daily functionality.
Eco-Friendly Upgrades: Sustainable materials and efficient fixtures reduce environmental impact.
Relaxing Sanctuary: Create a calm, inviting space for daily routines.

Ultimately, a bathroom renovation should reflect your needs, lifestyle, and the condition of your space. Your kitchen is one of the most important spaces in your home—it should be both functional and inviting. A thoughtful renovation can transform your kitchen into a stylish, comfortable, and efficient space that meets your family’s needs and reflects your personal taste.

Is It Time to Update Your Kitchen?

Normal wear and tear, such as cracked tiles, persistent leaks, or mold, is often the first sign that your kitchen needs a remodel. Other key reasons to renovate your kitchen include:

Upgrading to meet your family’s needs
Boosting your home’s resale value
Upgrading to fit your personal style

Upgraded appliances: New, high-performing appliances make cooking safer, faster, and more efficient, helping you tackle daily kitchen tasks like a pro.

Why Choose Bennett for Remodeling & Additions?

Large remodeling and addition projects require more than skilled carpentry. They demand coordination, foresight, and steady project management over weeks or months of work.

Homeowners trust Bennett because we offer:

A full-service remodeling and construction team
Experienced project managers overseeing every phase
Skilled in-house carpenters and licensed trade partners
Clear communication throughout planning and construction
Accurate, realistic estimates and timelines
Deep experience working in older Capital Region homes

Our approach is straightforward and professional. We don’t rely on high-pressure sales tactics. We focus on helping homeowners understand their options, make informed decisions, and move through complex projects with confidence.

What We Mean by “Remodeling & Home Additions”

Remodeling and additions cover a wide range of projects that go beyond single-room updates. These projects often involve structural changes, multi-room coordination, and long-term planning.

Whole-Home & Multi-Room Remodeling

For homeowners updating multiple spaces at once, we coordinate design, construction, and sequencing to ensure the work is cohesive and efficient. This may include kitchens, bathrooms, living areas, and circulation spaces—planned together, not in isolation.

Structural Changes & Reconfiguration

Many older homes were built for different lifestyles than today’s. Remodeling may involve removing or relocating walls, improving flow, reinforcing structure, or updating layouts to better support modern living.

Home Additions

When more space is needed, a home addition can expand living areas without sacrificing the character of your home. Common projects include primary suite additions, family rooms, in-law spaces, and expanded kitchens or living areas. Our goal is to make new construction feel intentional and integrated—not like an afterthought.

Common Reasons Homeowners Remodel or Add On

Homeowners throughout the Capital Region choose remodeling and additions for many reasons, including:

Outgrowing an existing layout
Adapting a home for long-term living or aging in place
Improving functionality in older homes
Creating space for extended family or guests
Preserving a location or neighborhood they love

These projects are often deeply personal and carefully considered. Our role is to help homeowners evaluate options and move forward with clarity.

Our Remodeling & Addition Process

A clear process is essential for larger-scale projects. Bennett’s approach is designed to reduce uncertainty and keep projects moving smoothly.

Initial Conversation & Evaluation

We begin by learning about your goals, your home, and the scope of work you’re considering. This early phase helps determine feasibility, priorities, and next steps.

Design & Planning

For projects requiring design, layouts, or structural planning, we collaborate with designers and engineers as needed. This phase allows details to be resolved before construction begins.

Pre-Construction & Permitting

We help guide homeowners through permitting requirements and scheduling. This stage ensures the project is properly prepared and compliant with local codes before work starts.

Construction & Project Management

During construction, our project managers coordinate trades, materials, and timelines. Communication remains consistent so homeowners know what to expect as work progresses.

Completion & Walkthrough

Once construction is complete, we review the finished work together, address final details, and ensure everything meets expectations.

Remodeling & Addition Projects by Bennett

Bennett Contracting has completed remodeling and addition projects throughout Albany, Schenectady, Saratoga, Troy, and surrounding communities. These projects reflect a wide range of home styles, scopes, and homeowner needs—each guided by careful planning and experienced execution.

Frequently Asked Questions About Remodeling & Home Additions
How long does a remodeling or home addition project take?

Timelines vary depending on scope, complexity, and permitting. Smaller remodels may take several weeks, while larger projects or additions can take several months. A realistic timeline is established during planning so expectations are clear before construction begins.

Do I need permits for a home addition or major remodel in New York?

Most remodeling and addition projects that affect structure, layout, or footprint require permits. Local requirements vary by municipality. Bennett helps homeowners navigate the permitting process and ensures work complies with applicable building codes.

Can I live in my home during remodeling or addition work?

In many cases, yes—but it depends on the scope of the project. Some homeowners remain in their homes during construction, while others choose temporary relocation for comfort or safety. This is discussed early so homeowners can plan accordingly.

How are remodeling and addition projects planned and sequenced?

Larger projects are broken into phases to maintain order and minimize disruption. Design, permitting, and pre-construction planning happen first, followed by carefully scheduled construction stages. Clear sequencing helps keep projects efficient and predictable.

How do you protect existing living areas during construction?

We take steps to limit disruption, including isolating work zones, protecting surfaces, and maintaining safe access throughout the home. While construction is never invisible, careful planning helps keep the process manageable.

Start the Conversation

If you’re considering a remodeling project or home addition and want to understand your options, our team is happy to talk through scope, timing, and next steps. Thoughtful planning is the foundation of a successful project, and we’re here to help guide that process.

Frequently Asked Questions

Ready to do some home remodeling but not sure where to start or how to proceed? Bennett’s trusted and experienced project managers can help. Click on the links below for answers to some common home remodeling questions to help get you started. Make sure your project is on the right track for success. Contact Bennett today for a free consultation and we’ll walk you through all the necessary steps to ensure your project is done right from the start.
