Home Improvement Financing
Make Your Dream Renovation a Reality

Flexible payment options through Regions Bank – from 9-month same-as-cash to low monthly payments that fit your budget.

Explore Options
Flexible Financing Options

At Keselman Construction Group, we believe financing your home improvement shouldn’t be complicated. That’s why we’ve partnered with Regions Bank to offer sensible financing solutions that fit your budget and timeline.

9-Month Same-As-Cash Loan

*Credit and loans provided by Regions Bank, Member FDIC, (650 S. Main St., Suite 1000, Salt Lake City, UT 84101) on approved credit, for a limited time. 19.99% fixed APR (provided however, APR will not exceed 15.99% for residents of New Jersey and 17.99% for residents of Florida and Wisconsin), effective as of July 2025, subject to change. Minimum loan amounts apply. Interest starts accruing when funds are disbursed. Interest waived if repaid in 270 days from first disbursement. When open line period ends, the balance becomes a fixed rate installment loan; repayment terms vary from 21 to 129 months. Actual loan term may be shorter if less than the full approved amount of credit is used. First monthly loan payment due 270 days after first disbursement. If no payments made during same-as-cash period and APR of 19.99%, monthly payments vary from $21.32 to $29.66 per $1,000 borrowed depending on term. The minimum monthly payment will be no less than $50.00.

Traditional Installment Loan

*Credit and loans provided by Regions Bank, Member FDIC, (650 S. Main St., Suite 1000, Salt Lake City, UT 84101) on approved credit, for a limited time. 8.99% to 24.49% fixed APR (provided however, APR will not exceed 15.99% for residents of New Jersey and 17.99% for residents of Florida and Wisconsin), subject to change. Minimum loan amounts apply. Interest starts accruing when funds are disbursed. Open line period payments due 90 days after origination and monthly thereafter during open line period. When open line period ends, the balance becomes a fixed rate installment loan; repayment terms vary from 12 to 144 months. Actual loan term may be shorter if less than the full approved amount of credit is used. First monthly loan payment due 30 days from the end of the open line period. Monthly payments vary from $11.49 to $30.27 per $1,000 borrowed depending on term and interest rate. The minimum monthly payment will be no less than $50.00.

11.99% APR Up To 12-Yr Loan

*Credit and loans provided by Regions Bank, Member FDIC, (650 S. Main St., Suite 1000, Salt Lake City, UT 84101) on approved credit, for a limited time. 11.99% fixed APR, subject to change. Minimum loan amounts apply. Interest starts accruing when funds are disbursed. Open line period payments due 90 days after origination and monthly thereafter during open line period. When open line period ends, the balance becomes a fixed rate installment loan; repayment terms vary from 12 to 144 months. Actual loan term may be shorter if less than the full approved amount of credit is used. First monthly loan payment due 30 days from the end of the open line period. Monthly payments vary from $13.42 to $32.96 per $1,000 borrowed depending on term. The minimum monthly payment will be no less than $50.00.

What to Expect with a Remodel?
Our Process

Our Tried and True Process Delivers Outstanding Results – Every Time. Keselman Construction Group offers a unique, 6-step home remodeling process that begins with a simple conversation and ends when you’re happy with the completed project.

1) Initial Conversation & Consultation

The initial conversation and consultation we have with you is the beginning of our relationship. Whether you know what you want or you’re still thinking it through, our Estimate Consultant will meet with you at your home or our office and walk you through the process. If a project requires an architect and/or engineer, we can connect you with professionals we have worked with before. If your project requires a designer, we have a wonderful designer on staff, but we’ll gladly work with yours as well. We will also do our best to provide you with an approximate estimate for your project based on your ideas to make sure it’s within your budget.

2) Design

We begin the design process with asking questions, and listening to what you are looking to accomplish with your renovation project. This helps us establish some parameters and direction for the new design, and get the idea of the style and feel you are looking to accomplish. Next, our designer will produce a floor plan layout and 3D renderings to help you visualize your new space. There will be an open discussion and an opportunity to revise the designs before they are finalized. The goal is to design a space that is both functional and a true expression of your style.

3) Pricing & Planning

Once the designs or blueprint are completed, we send the drawings to necessary supplier for accurate material prices. Meanwhile, our estimating team will assemble a detailed proposal including all the necessary labor scope of work and allowance budget for finish materials. The estimating process typically takes two weeks or less, but it’s worth the wait because our clients routinely express how thankful they are that our estimates are thoroughly detailed and easy-to-understand.

When we have compiled all the necessary information, we will email the estimate to you and then schedule a follow-up to review it and make any changes necessary. Finally, we prepare a contract and draw schedule based on the latest, approved estimate.

4) Pre-Production

After the contract is signed and the down payment received, the scheduling begins! Before construction, all the finish materials need to be selected to ensure timely ordering. We highly recommend working with our designer and our preferred vendors to expedite the process and get you pointed in the right direction. We will also assign a Project Manager to your project and perform a job site walk through with both the Project Manager and the Estimate Consultant present. Finally, our team creates a timeline in our project management software and includes you in the communications so you can follow the updates and work process.

5) Construction

Once the required materials arrive and the necessary permits are obtained, we can begin construction. The Project Manager will facilitate communication between you, our suppliers and professional tradesmen to make sure things run smoothly and the timeline is followed. Whether you choose to work or stay at home during construction, we’ll do everything possible to minimize the disruption to your life. However, sometimes the work being performed does require you to vacate the premises or lose function of a portion of your, but we’ll let you know in advance LONG before that happens.

6) Completion & Quality Assurance

At this point, our clients are quite excited because their dream project is nearly complete! Once the majority of the construction is complete, your Project Manager will schedule a walk through with you and create a punch list documenting any incomplete/unsatisfactory items. Once the punch list is compiled, the touch-up crew will address every item. Your warranty begins after we complete this process.

We Know How You Feel

Remodeling or renovating your home, or even just a small portion of it, is both exciting and a little unnerving for many homeowners. We work very closely with each of our clients and do our best to reduce stress and mitigate feelings of uneasiness with good communication and proper planning. However, we’ve learned over the years that our clients moods often change in direct correlation to where we are within the project. We then found this graphic from a remodeling company in Seattle (credit: Model Remodel, Seattle, WA) that perfectly illustrates the emotional experience of many homeowners…even if they are thrilled with the completed project.

Why do we share this with you? Because it’s important for you to know that we understand your feelings throughout the entire remodeling process and will do everything we can to help you through each and every step!

It started on a rugby field

Our partnership started on a rugby field, where we learned the value of skill, hard work and collaboration. 

When we met, Eric was an engineer in the high tech automation industry and Craig had recently completed a demanding four-year building apprenticeship program in New Zealand, his native country, where construction standards are high and workers are known for their obsessive dedication to excellence.  

We saw an opportunity to use our unique skill sets to form a partnership off the field and create a new type of construction company that makes remodeling less stressful and more transparent. 

For more than two decades, we have provided high-quality kitchen remodels, bath renovations, and additions to Santa Cruz County homeowners.  We’re selective about the projects we take on and we always deliver high-quality work backed by our Elite guarantee.

A big bonus for us was the care they showed our multiple animals. It helped make the whole experience easier to live with. We highly recommend their services!”

Is a bathroom renovation possible in the near future? Maybe, and if we do decide to move forward, it'll be with Elite Construction Services -- no need to engage with any other contractors.”

Scott, Craig, Eric, and their subcontractors patiently explained each issue and the best solution to ensure the final project would last and look fantastic. Lori and Will were a dream to work with.  For a hyper-organized person like myself, Elite was a dream to work with. Our next big project is the kitchen, and I will definitely use Elite.”

headings: H3: What does each category mean?
pages.text:
Skip to Content
Contact
About
Blog
Transparent project pricing

We believe transparency and trust go hand in hand. We include a complete breakdown of labor, materials and subcontractors costs, so that you have an exact understanding of where your money is being spent. 

We are always happy to provide a free no obligation, preliminary estimate for any project you are considering. 

Estimated kitchen costs
Kitchen

Economy      40k+

Better            55k+

Best               65k+  

Large Kitchen

Economy      45k+

Better             65k+

Best                100k+

Item 1 of 2
Estimated bathroom renovation costs
Medium bathroom

Economy      20k+

Better            25k+

Best              35k+  

Large bathroom

Economy      20k+

Better             35k+

Best                60k+

Item 1 of 2
What does each category mean?

“Economy”

This is what a typical Income/rental property remodel might cost. We don’t work on projects at this level, but if you shop around you can find contractors that do.

“Better”

Includes cabinet upgrades such as soft close drawers and full extension glides and upgraded appliances and fixtures. Counter tops may be quartz or granite with a decorative backsplash. It may also include some minor site modifications.

“Best”

Includes high-end custom cabinetry, designer fixtures and restaurant grade appliances. It may include relocating load bearing walls, appliances and/or plumbing fixtures.

Schedule a consultation

“Elite is an amazing group of people, not only excellent at what they do, but just good, caring folks.  After a year, every time I walk into my kitchen (and it is clean), I feel gratitude for Alison's design brilliance and Craig and the crew’s hard work. The only thing you won't like about Elite is that after doing a fantastic job, you won't see them every day.”

-Susan P, Santa Cruz

pages.text:
Skip to Content
Contact
About
Blog
Our process is clear

Our goal is provide you with as much information as possible so you can create your ideal space without breaking the bank or losing your mind.

Call or email us with your ideas for your project.  If you want to share photos of your current space and your design ideas, Pinterest boards, or Houzz boards, it helps us give you a ballpark idea of cost.  This will help you determine if we are a good fit for your building project.

1. Initial consultation
Schedule a consultation

Our designer will schedule a visit to your home to discuss your tastes and personal style. We want to get a feel for your desires for your project and your budget requirements so we can provide you with an accurate bid. 

2. Site visit
Schedule a consultation

Let’s review your project estimate.  We’ll go through the bid line by line and answer any questions you might have.  Various design and construction options will be presented so you can adjust your project to fit your budget and the look of the final outcome. 

3. Estimate
Schedule a consultation

You’ve seen the initial plans and have had some time to price out appliances, fixtures and other accessories.  Time to finalize your project layout so we can get started.

4. Finalize your design
Schedule a consultation

Start your project with the assurance that you will be in conversation with us during the whole process.  Our online portal gives you detailed timelines for materials needed (such as tile, fixtures, etc.) and install dates for all phases.  The portal also shows you a running total of expenses so you can keep track of your budget..

5. Build it
Schedule a consultation
6. Relax and enjoy

You did it!  Delight in your completed project.  Rest assured that should any issues arise, we’ve got you covered by the Elite guarantee.  

Schedule a consultation

It started on a rugby field

Our partnership started on a rugby field, where we learned the value of skill, hard work and collaboration. 

When we met, Eric was an engineer in the high tech automation industry and Craig had recently completed a demanding four-year building apprenticeship program in New Zealand, his native country, where construction standards are high and workers are known for their obsessive dedication to excellence.  

We saw an opportunity to use our unique skill sets to form a partnership off the field and create a new type of construction company that makes remodeling less stressful and more transparent. 

For more than two decades, we have provided high-quality kitchen remodels, bath renovations, and additions to Santa Cruz County homeowners.  We’re selective about the projects we take on and we always deliver high-quality work backed by our Elite guarantee.
